Players Committee card image of [[Ancient Watering Hole]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Maz and your Rep are immune to attrition. While you have alien characters of five different species on table: your Force drains are +1, your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if Maz or your Rep in battle), and your aliens are forfeit +1. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/ancientwateringhole.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/ancientwateringhole.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
